mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of UNRATE > 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for two consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month MA - 3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is below its 12-month MA by more than 3% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both GDPC1 and HOUST above their respective 3-month moving averages signals strengthening housing and overall demand, which boosts corporate earnings and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 3-month MA and HOUST > 3-month MA simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 3-month MAs.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PAYEMS above 0.5% month-over-month and a decrease in UNRATE below 3.5% signals a loosening labor market with still-growing employment, which supports corporate profit margins and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: transition from tight to easing labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS > +0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in CPIAUCSL above 4% month-over-month, combined with a simultaneous decrease in FEDFUNDS below 3%, signals a surprise inflationary shock with delayed monetary tightening, which erodes real equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 4% MoM and FEDFUNDS < 3% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 4% MoM and FEDFUNDS < 3% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on positive correlation exists between RSAFS growth above 2% month-over-month and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting increased consumer savings translating into future spending and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: No significant positive correlation between RSAFS > 2% MoM and S&P 500 20-day forward returns over a 5-year rolling window.
